channel.description: Knitting patterns and notes from the workbench — handmade knitwear from Lansing, Michigan. From my den to your home.

item.title: On the Needles: Grandmother's Favorite Washcloths
item.description: A workbench update: washcloths are going on the needles next — a Grandmother's Favorite set of three in burgundy, white, and olive garden, with the classic pattern free to knit along.

item.title: Textured Seed Stitch Washcloth — Free Knitting Pattern
item.description: A free hand-knit washcloth pattern in seed stitch with a garter border. Sturdy, nubby, and lies flat — knit by hand on needles in worsted cotton.
